summary: Iteration 2 testing (receipt uploads + verification/admin). Backend: 27/27 pytest tests passed covering POST /upload (auth-gated, image-only, kind validation), GET /files/{path} ACL (owner/admin/teacher-of-enrollment allowed; others 403; unauth 401; ?token= also works), /courses/{id}/enroll with receipt_path only / neither / someone-else's file, /teacher/requests includes receipt_path, /verification/request (teacher-only, foreign-file 400, already-verified 400), /admin/verifications pending|approved|rejected, /admin/stats, approve/reject propagation to teacher_verified on courses, register with role=admin returns 422. Real Emergent Object Storage round-trips succeeded (no transient 500s during run). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): admin@tbib.dz lands on /admin screen; admin-screen, admin-tabs (Segmented), admin-logout-button all present; stats render 4 students / 2 instructors / 2 verified / 0 pending (correct after approving major in backend tests). major@tbib.dz login → tab-profile → profile-verification-card → /verification shows status banner 'حسابك موثّق ✓' (since major is now approved); upload/submit buttons correctly hidden in approved state. student@tbib.dz home shows 4 course-card-badge-{id}-verified badges (3 teacher + 1 major, now that major is verified). Checkout screen for student → checkout-receipt-upload, checkout-ref-input, checkout-submit-button all render. No red screen, no backend 500s observed.

issues: Pre-existing react-native-web warnings persist (props.pointerEvents / shadow* deprecation). No functional impact.

action_items: Seed state note: major@tbib.dz is now verified=true (verification_status=approved) because the admin-approve test exercised real admin endpoints. If next iteration needs major to remain unverified for a UI retest, main agent should reset in Mongo: db.users.update_one({email:'major@tbib.dz'}, {$set:{verified:false, verification_status:'none', verification_doc:null, verification_note:null, verification_reason:null, verification_requested_at:null}}) and db.courses.update_many({teacher_id:'<majorId>'}, {$set:{teacher_verified:false}}).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~844 lines — above the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth, courses, lessons, enrollments, reviews, ai, files, verification/admin).
put_object retry logic initializes storage_key before retrying but doesn't retry on all 5xx (only re-inits key on 503). Minor; current flow worked.

/files/{path:path} accepts auth via Authorization header OR ?token= query — good for native <Image> which can't send headers. ACL correctly scoped: owner | admin | enrollment teacher for receipts only (verification docs are owner+admin only).
enroll endpoint validates receipt ownership (owner_id==user.id, is_deleted:false) — good.
verification/request validates kind==='verification' and ownership — good.
admin cannot be registered publicly: RegisterIn.role Literal['student','teacher'] enforces 422. Admin seeded idempotently from env.
No input sanitization on verification_note/reason beyond length-less string — OK for internal UI but consider length caps.
